A right rectangular prism has a length of 26 centimeters $( c m )$, a width of $16 \mathrm{cm}$, and a
height of $14 \mathrm{cm}$. What is the surface area, in $c m 2$ , of the right rectangular
prism?
The $y$-intercept of the graph of $y=81.65 x$ in the $xy$-plane is 0, $y$. What is the value of $y$?

The function $f ( x )=180 ( x - 2 )$ gives the sum of the interior angles, in degrees, for a
polygon with $x$ sides. What is the sum of the interior angles, in degrees, for a polygon with 14
sides？

In March, an account manager completed 15 more than 3 times the number of sales the account
manager completed in April. In March and April, the account manager completed 327 sales. How
many sales did the account manager complete in April?

Triangle $QRS$ is similar to triangle $FGH$ such that $Q$, $R$, and $S$ correspond to $F$, $G$ and $H$,
respectively. Each side of triangle $FGH$ has the $\frac{1}{4}$ length of its corresponding side in triangle
$QRS$. In triangle $FGH$, the measure of angle $F$ is $35^{\circ}$, the measure of angle $G$ is $8^{\circ}$, and $FG=a$. In
triangle $QRS$, the measure of angle $Q$ is $b^{\circ}$ and $Q R=20$. What is the value of $a+b$?

The area of a triangle is equal to $x 2$ quare centimeters. The length of the base of the
triangle is $2 x+12.5$ centimeters,and the height of the triangle is $x - 5$ centimeters.What is
the value of $x$?

A right circular cylinder has a radius of 12 centimeters and a volume of 2 , $448 \pi$ cubic
centimeters. What is the height, in centimeters, of the cylinder?

$$x=2+8yx=4-8y$$
The solution to the given system of equations is $(x,y)$. What is the value of $2x$?

For a particular car, the linear function $f$ gives the predicted power, in brake horsepower (bhp),
for engine speeds between 1,000 revolutions per minute (rpm) and 6,000 rpm. According to this
function, the car’$s$ predicted power is 228 bhp at an engine speed of 1,896 rpm and 600 bhp at an
engine speed of 4,500 rpm. The equation $f ( x )=\frac{1}{7} ( x - a )+228$ defines $f$, where $x$ is
the engine speed, in rpm, and $a$ is a constant. What is the value of $a$?

$$33x2+(33s+r)x+rs=0$$

equation is $kr s$, where $k$ is a constant. What is the value of $k$?

$xy$-plane, the graph of $y=p(x)$ passes through the points$(-7,24)$and $(0, 899)$.what is the value
of $p(-12)+p(-5)$?
